verdict.T25: Headline 8.97% is cut most by account size (W0 300M: 8.04%, -0.93pp) and cost 0.45%/side (8.09%, -0.89pp). cost 0.45%/side pushes it OUT of the -25% tier (WD -25.67%, SPX29 leg); re-selection then gives v1|s0.1|L1.0|K1|RC at 4.43%. In KRW (DEXKOUS) its real-NDX MDD is -27.73% (USD -19.05%) -> out of tier in KRW terms. 7y bond keeps it in tier but re-selection flips the tier pick to DF2|M2|b1|v1|s0.15|L1.0|K1|RB (10.79%, WD -24.90%).
verdict.T30: Sits on the -30% boundary (WD -29.97%): 6 of 8 single realistic variants push it out (W0 30M/100M/300M, bond ER 0.25%, harvest off, cost 0.45%). Largest headline drop: cost 0.45% (10.18 -> 8.87%); W0 300M 9.17%. Re-selected tier headline then ranges 9.34%-11.75% with 4 different configs. KRW real-NDX MDD -32.40% (USD -21.02%) -> out of tier in KRW terms.
verdict.T40: Stays in the -40% tier under every variant and both combos (worst WD -39.57% at cost 0.45%). Largest headline drop W0 300M (13.24 -> 12.40%). But its ADOPTION is fragile: the corrected bond-excess gate (gate_fix.py, select_df2_fixed.json) already rejects it at base (9.55% < 9.82%) -> v1|s0.3|L1.0|K2|RB 11.42%; with the original gate it is also rejected at W0 >= 30M and bond ER 0.25%. KRW real-NDX MDD -37.56% (in tier).
verdict.refs: QQQ 1x hold moves <= 0.08pp in every variant (KRW real-NDX MDD -81.0% vs USD -83.0%). v1 15.18% -> 14.74% at W0 300M, 14.87% at cost 0.45%, 14.89% harvest off; KRW real-NDX MDD -65.7% vs USD -70.0%.
verdict.krw_reselection: With only the real-NDX leg in KRW, the -25% tier is empty and the -30% tier pick becomes DF2|M0|b2|v1|s0.2|L1.0|K1|RB 10.85% (DF2 gate not applied; DF1 best v1|s0.1|L3.0|K2|RB 9.31%). With bootstrapped FX on the paths too (NON-ACTUAL), only static QQQ30/bond survives any tier (-40%).
